tasks.title: Choose and document one inference architecture, with alternatives
tasks.description: Compare deterministic-only advice, the existing direct-provider adapter and central FM inference. Select the current flow, credential owner, fallback and usage owner. Separate Command metrics from inference. Label other designs deferred/superseded rather than building extra integration layers.
acceptance: One coherent diagram/status/activation description and concrete trade-offs for rejected alternatives.

tasks.title: Reconcile delivery status and explain the existing evidence path
tasks.description: Separate service logic, Portal input availability, model activation, durable audit, usage persistence and external certification. Document PortalSurfaceEvidenceProvider and its trust obligations; missing projections do not justify another ingestion service. Move capability-specific limitations beside the affected journey.
acceptance: A consistent current status table and a request-to-authorized-evidence explanation identifying rejection/classification limitations and user-visible behavior.

tasks.title: Define the mandatory governance boundary for model activation
tasks.description: The inspected service accepts absent audit, ledger and entitlements; composition can use logging instead of durable audit. Specify the authoritative composition guarantee and permitted development exception. Reuse ControlPlaneAuditSink; distinguish missing dependencies from post-call write failure.
acceptance: An explicit activation/failure contract and evidence for enforcement before any claim of no audit, no AI. No production bypass is claimed by this review.

tasks.title: Separate request replay, provider attempts and usage accounting
tasks.description: Repeated logical requests can invoke a model again while request-only deduplication suppresses usage; the key omits scope. Failed or timed-out attempts may have unknown consumption. Define scoped identity, payload equivalence, attempt accounting and uncertainty before adding persistence or settlement machinery.
acceptance: Documented replay/attempt semantics and bounded recovery policy; provider reconciliation only where evidence supports it. Do not reuse fiscal issuance storage for advisory calls.

tasks.title: Close and describe the prompt metadata boundary
tasks.description: Evidence IDs and keys bypass the cleanup applied to values/origins/questions. Define validated opaque IDs and allowed keys or sanitize the full rendered surface, preserving unique citation identities. Use existing contracts, Redactor and ContextPackBuilder.
acceptance: A field-level boundary identifying what may reach each provider and where validation/redaction occurs. Static observations are not evidence of an actual external leak.

tasks.title: Specify bounded input, model work and quota assumptions
tasks.description: Evidence item count does not bound mapping cardinality or aggregate context. State fields/bytes/tokens, output, fallback attempts and concurrency limits. Describe soft per-process quota, restart behavior, non-atomic admission and distinct provider-side spend controls.
acceptance: A bounded operating envelope and clear oversized/invalid-input behavior. Durable storage must not be described as atomic cross-process admission by itself.

tasks.title: Make context identity retain source, time and catalog applicability
tasks.description: The current hash omits origin and as_of; response provenance does not require a catalog/effective-date snapshot. Define canonical evidence identity and unknown temporal applicability using existing fields and stable_hash.
acceptance: The documented hash/provenance contract distinguishes relevant source/time/version changes and points to immutable evidence. No new provenance platform is justified.

tasks.title: State the concrete operator problem and first useful outcome
tasks.description: Replace maximal cognition and anthropomorphic claims with the accountant/operator task, existing workflow problem, expected advice and benefit of optional model enrichment over the baseline.
acceptance: A concise measurable problem/goal statement and smallest usable journey. Capability expansion is not a substitute for missing evidence inputs.

tasks.title: Link project-specific delivery and integration terms
tasks.description: Provide navigable definitions for task IDs and Integration Fabric without turning this architecture into a second master plan.
acceptance: References resolve to the governing task index and integration contract.

tasks.title: Label response-contract representation
tasks.description: Separate Python field names and enum members from HTTP serialization names and values.
acceptance: Exact contract names or an explicitly illustrative representation linked to its serializer.
